newsitem.title: NORWAY: Fokus 1996 profits up on regional banking.
newsitem.headline: Fokus 1996 profits up on regional banking.

text.p: Norway's third largest commercial bank, Fokus Bank ASA, announced on Thursday that 1996 pre-tax operating profits rose 7.7 percent to 462 million crowns ($71.5 million) from a year earlier thanks to successful regional banking.
The bank said earnings per share amounted to 7.03 crowns and proposed a divided of four crowns to shareholders.

"The result confirms the fact that our regional stategy is paying off in terms of increased market shares and low loan losses," Managing Director Bjarne Borgersen said in a statement. "Through our regional banking strategy, we emphasize local expertise and decentralised authorities," he said.
The sale of shares in information technology company NOVIT AS, which gave Fokus a profit of more than 100 million crowns, contributed substantially to the result.
The statement said the accounts had been charged with a provision of 119 million crowns for restructuring activities related to real estate and personnel.
"The restructuring will contribute to a positive cost development," it said.
Operating expenses increased to 969 million from 959 million in 1995.

"The cost level is stable despite larger investments in 1996," Borgersen said. "The entire banking industry faces considerable competitive challenges, which implicates changes and restructuring. The restructuring provision has been made in order to meet these challenges."
The bank reported increased net lending and increased market shares in 1996. But net interest income fell to 912 million crowns from 959 million in 1995 thanks to tight interest margins.
The pre-tax operating profits of 462 million crowns, up from 429 million in 1995, fell short of market expectations of a result of about 550 million crowns.

Other operating income rose to 436 million crowns from 421 million to help make up for the lowered net interest income. The operating result before losses/writebacks came to 379 million crowns, down from 421 million.
Fokus was the first of Norway's major banks to present annual 1996 results.
